Onecoin is a cryptographic currency created digitally based on advanced mathematical algorithms born thanks to the axis of Bitcoin. But onecoin is not a prize currency. The members can create their own currency, mine it and get their profits. Wankoin is exchanged for a public exchange market. With a good lucrative and simple compensation plan, wankoin will be the next most profitable cryptocurrency in the market. And what do the algorithm work like? each algorithm for a legitimate cryptocurrency should have a number of fixed or limited solutions, called coins, the WANCOIN has exactly 2.1 billion of coins, that is, there is no possibility possibility of reproducing or eliminating a single coin from this inventory ... since the mathematical algorithm does not allow it. Everything is governed by the mathematical algorithm and there is no possibility of changing the value of this cryptocurrency until mining starts. Cryptocurrencies can only be produced with three coins. It's as simple as in the example below. That is to say, there are only three correct answers to reach the total sum of 5, which would be 3 plus 2, or 4 plus 1 to be exact, or 5 plus 0. In this other case, we would have exactly three coins as a reward. The incredible history of Bitcoin's success, for those who don't know, I'm going to explain some of the examples of what happened at the beginning, and how the value of this coin has a small amount of Bitcoin. With just part of the coins he bought a luxury apartment. This news was published in several newspapers in 2013. At first it was worth just 1$ , like you can see on graphic of this video. You can see how far this price went up. Another example which reaches to be comical and not to be real, it's the first bitcoin offline transaction. Where in 2010 a man bought a pizza, and, because of the lack of trust of those coins that it was hard, he paid 10,000 bitcoin coins for the pizza. The highest price for this coin was 7 million dollars. In short, this was considered, considered THE expensive pizza in the world The $ 7 Million Pizza And why a coin, better than bitcoin? First, It has a much more advanced and safe algorithm Lower denomination, limited to 2.1 Billions of coins making them more accessible to all One only exchange, due to its centralization, offering more liquidity and less volatility.
